ينسلب (form VII)
# يَنْسَلِبُ (yansalibu) /jan.sa.li.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
# يَنْسَلِبَ (yansaliba) /jan.sa.li.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
# يَنْسَلِبْ (yansalib) /jan.sa.lib/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
